content: Hi all, I was looking at the page for Konig's lemma and noticed a todo about specializing to the graph-theoretic statement. I'm interested in tackling this as a first mathlib issue if it's still open, any advice?

Not sure if relevant but I proved the special case for (possibly) infinite trees of finite (not necessarily bounded) degree in one of my projects in case you want to take a look :)
https://github.com/monsterkrampe/Possibly-Infinite-Trees/blob/main/PossiblyInfiniteTrees/PossiblyInfiniteTree/FiniteDegreeTree/KoenigsLemma.lean
